note_replies: v8.23: replies=true -> x_live.py reads the timeline WITH replies (FxTwitter ?with_replies=1) and keeps every reply, not only ones naming a coin; vip=true -> server push for every new post / reply (tools/kyvo_push.py VIP block). v8.24: push is no longer for every post — see vip_push (important-tweet filter).

vip_push.note: v8.24 ⭐ important-tweet push (tools/kyvo_push.py). The New Tweet feed still shows EVERY post; only pushes are filtered. Per-account vip_rule: 'posts' = every ORIGINAL post (not replies) pushes, replies only if important; 'keywords' = post or reply pushes only if its text (+ quoted post, + the post it replies to) hits a keyword / cashtag / named coin, or its early engagement passes the thresholds; 'all' = old v8.23 behaviour (every post + reply). Env KYVO_VIP_DAY_CAP / KYVO_VIP_GAP_S override day_cap / gap_s. 'crypto' (big crypto names, no ⭐ in the feed): push only when the post names a coin / $CASHTAG / contract address, hits a crypto_keywords word, or passes engagement_crypto. Accounts with vip=true (Elon, Trump, Kimchi) are the ⭐ VIP chip in the app; vip_rule alone only enables the push.

engagement.note: reached while the post is ≤ max_age_min old: likes ≥ min_likes, OR likes/min since posting ≥ likes_per_min (counted only from 5 min old), OR views ≥ min_views. Elon's ordinary posts sit around 5–15k likes at ~1.5 h (data/x_live.json, 2026-10-31).

vip_push.keywords_note: case-insensitive whole-word match ('sol' does not hit 'solid'); any $CASHTAG or a coin the server resolved in the tweet also counts.
